citation: Professional Crisis Management Association (PCMA): Justification of Restraint
rationale: Physical safety management procedures are highly restrictive and carry legal liability. They can ONLY be utilized in the presence of continuous, imminent danger (Aggression, SIB, Elopement, Pica).

citation: Professional Crisis Management Association (PCMA): Absence of Crisis
rationale: Highly restrictive physical interventions cannot logically occur concurrently with client states indicating calmness, lethargy, or independent functioning. Such pairings indicate either a documentation error or an unethical application of restraint.
